interpretation_boundary: All five profiles are unconfigured templates. None has approved numeric thresholds or authorized use. Measurement lists are candidate requirements, not completed measurements. A profile must not become active until domain-specific constraints, methods, uncertainty requirements and independent review evidence are recorded.

profiles.title: Cropped agricultural root zone
profiles.primary_service: Maintain plant-accessible water while preserving infiltration, aeration, drainage and nutrient control.
profiles.description: Agricultural root-zone profile. Lower water conductivity is not automatically beneficial; evaluate water supply, infiltration, aeration, drainage, plant response and nutrient losses together.

measurement_requirements.method: Method and ring/column geometry require protocol selection
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Initial state and wetting/drying branch declared
measurement_requirements.sampling_support: Plot or independently randomized core; event time series

measurement_requirements.method: Branch-labelled retention curve with declared pressure range
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Main drying, main wetting and supported scanning paths
measurement_requirements.sampling_support: Independent core / specimen and pressure-step replicates

measurement_requirements.method: Air-filled porosity or oxygen-diffusion method to be qualified
measurement_requirements.state_condition: At matched water potential and temperature

measurement_requirements.method: Synchronized measured drainage with concentration / collected mass
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Event boundary and collection window declared

measurement_requirements.endpoint: Plant water stress and crop response
measurement_requirements.method: Crop- and stage-specific measurement protocol
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Crop stage and weather sequence declared
measurement_requirements.sampling_support: Randomized experimental unit and harvest/measurement unit

applicability_scope.soil_domain: Mineral agricultural soils; texture, mineralogy and depth range must be specified per study.
applicability_scope.climate_domain: Rainfed or irrigated; rainfall intensity, dry spells and seasonal distribution must be declared.
applicability_scope.management_system: Crop, rooting depth, tillage, residue, irrigation and organic-input history must be declared.

expected_failure_modes: Root restriction or reduced crop service

governance.reviewer_role: independent domain-qualified reviewer required before activation

profiles.title: Dryland water resilience
profiles.primary_service: Capture and retain useful water across drought-to-intense-rain sequences without unacceptable runoff, deep loss or nutrient export.
profiles.description: Dryland profile focused on sequences of dry spells, intense rainfall, antecedent moisture and recovery, not a single average storm.

measurement_requirements.method: Rainfall simulator or calibrated field measurement protocol
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Antecedent moisture and pulse sequence declared

measurement_requirements.method: Depth-integrated water content with measured bulk density / geometry
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Before, during and after each sequence

measurement_requirements.method: Drainage or lysimeter flow plus synchronized analyte mass
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Event integration and recovery declared

measurement_requirements.method: Declared crop/pasture physiology or growth endpoint
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Drought, rewetting and recovery windows

applicability_scope.soil_domain: Locally characterized dryland soils, depth and restrictive horizons declared.
applicability_scope.climate_domain: Observed or scenario-based drought and intense-rain sequences with provenance.
applicability_scope.management_system: Rainfed crop/pasture/cover management, surface cover, residue and rooting system declared.

expected_failure_modes: Benefits limited to non-representative rainfall sequences

governance.reviewer_role: independent domain-qualified reviewer required before activation

profiles.title: Engineered low-permeability cover
profiles.primary_service: Limit water percolation and gas transport while maintaining structural integrity under declared climatic cycles.
profiles.description: Engineered cover profile. Low water and gas transport may be desirable here, but must be evaluated with crack formation, deformation, settlement, vegetation effects and climate durability.

measurement_requirements.method: Instrumented column or field lysimeter with boundary flux accounting
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Declared suction, compaction and wetting/drying sequence

measurement_requirements.method: Qualified gas-permeability method
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Matched moisture and temperature state

measurement_requirements.method: Image-based crack geometry plus settlement/deformation survey
measurement_requirements.state_condition: After each declared cycle and stress

measurement_requirements.method: Depth-resolved pressure transducers with calibration
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Calibrated rainfall/irrigation and initial state

applicability_scope.soil_domain: Engineered compacted cover material and layer geometry must be specified.
applicability_scope.climate_domain: Rainfall, evaporation, temperature and wetting/drying cycle envelope declared.
applicability_scope.management_system: Compaction specification, vegetation/root design, construction and maintenance regime declared.

expected_failure_modes: Apparent low permeability caused by unmeasured boundary artefact

governance.reviewer_role: independent domain-qualified reviewer required before activation

profiles.title: Vegetated slope and embankment
profiles.primary_service: Limit hazardous cracking, erosion and pore-pressure response while preserving appropriate infiltration, drainage and vegetation function.
profiles.description: Slope profile. A permeability change must be evaluated with transient pressure, shear/mechanical stability and surface erosion; neither lower nor higher conductivity is universally beneficial.

measurement_requirements.method: Image-derived crack intensity with spatial support and repeatability
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Before and after each stress sequence

measurement_requirements.method: Calibrated pressure transducers
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Storm pulse and antecedent state declared

measurement_requirements.method: Rainfall simulator or field flux measurement
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Declared slope, surface cover and event forcing

measurement_requirements.method: Qualified geotechnical test and deformation monitoring
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Declared stress and moisture path

applicability_scope.soil_domain: Slope soil/engineered fill, stratigraphy, density and geometry declared.
applicability_scope.climate_domain: Storm intensity/duration, antecedent moisture and drying history declared.
applicability_scope.management_system: Vegetation species/root architecture, construction, drainage and slope geometry declared.

governance.reviewer_role: independent domain-qualified reviewer required before activation

profiles.title: Horticultural substrate
profiles.primary_service: Maintain a reproducible water/air balance and reliable rewetting while avoiding repellency, collapse, salinity and nutrient imbalance.
profiles.description: Growing-media profile. Substrates are a distinct material domain and must not be treated as field mineral soil without an explicit population crosswalk.

measurement_requirements.method: Substrate-specific retention and container-capacity method
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Defined wetting/drying branch and packing density

measurement_requirements.method: Volume-based air porosity at declared water state
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Matched suction or container capacity

measurement_requirements.method: Method appropriate to growing-media geometry
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Initial state and wetting/drying history

measurement_requirements.method: Declared repellency test and wetting-front observation
measurement_requirements.state_condition: After defined drying and storage

measurement_requirements.method: Crop-specific growth/root health and nutrient endpoints
measurement_requirements.state_condition: Crop stage and irrigation sequence

applicability_scope.soil_domain: Named substrate formulation, particle-size distribution and component batch declared.
applicability_scope.climate_domain: Container geometry, irrigation pulse, drying interval and temperature declared.
applicability_scope.management_system: Crop/container system, fertigation, reuse and substrate ageing regime declared.

governance.reviewer_role: independent domain-qualified reviewer required before activation
